description: Use this skill whenever auditing, reviewing, or testing Python web applications (FastAPI or Flask) for OWASP A09:2025 — Security Logging & Alerting Failures. Trigger this skill when the user mentions: logging security, audit trails, log injection, sensitive data in logs, alerting gaps, insufficient logging, SIEM integration, log monitoring, incident detection readiness, or any request to audit or fix logging/alerting in a Python backend. Also trigger when a user asks "are we logging the right things?", "how do I detect attacks?", or "what should we be alerting on?". Do NOT skip this skill just because the request sounds simple — log-related security issues are consistently underestimated and require systematic coverage across all five CWEs.
